name: Phrygia
alt: Mushki (Assyrian name, identified with the Phrygians by most historians for Midas's time)

successors.name: Lydia
successors.text: the Phrygian highlands, which Lydia 'extended over' after expelling the Cimmerians by around 620 BC, and the Troad taken by Gyges after Phrygia's collapse

ledger.x: 715: Phrygia and Assyria come to blows.
709: Phrygia submits and a truce is struck.

wars.name: Phrygian-Assyrian conflict
wars.outcome: A truce and Phrygian submission by 709 under Sargon II; some eastern Phrygian land was later incorporated by the Assyrians.

wars.name: Cimmerian sack of Gordion
wars.outcome: Gordium sacked and burned; Midas dies; the kingdom does not recover.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a Phrygian border; the whole life is soft.
